content.title: Jay Clayton: Trump's 'Friend' Label for Putin is 'Completely Appropriate'
content.caption: Jay Clayton, the US director of national intelligence, says he trusts Donald Trump 'completely' after Trump called Putin 'a friend' during their recent meeting in China.
